conditional_findings.severity: unassigned; previously recorded standalone physical-grade tolerance, bounded input example source-reasoned
conditional_findings.first_contract: A reported successful physical grade constraint needs an explicit representable tolerance that does not erase a material rise solely because of the absolute elevation offset.
conditional_findings.classification: Original059 Adler finding reassessed against identical95e source. Its later prior qualifications remain intact; no historical unique increment.
conditional_findings.trace: The original standalone example uses a2×2 admitted SceneTerrain at spacing1m with heights [100000000,100000008,100000000,100000008]. Both f32 heights are representable; grade::constrain measures an8m rise but its absolute-magnitude-based allowance is about47.7m, so the initial allowance can return success without changing samples. Current source still uses the identical calculation. The original059 later records show the selected TacticalSceneInput validates source heights within ±12000m, excluding that specific1e8 example.
conditional_findings.bounded_source_illustration: A separate newly assessed symbolic example uses spacing0.25m, A=8192m and representable delta85/512m, with row-major heights [A,A+delta,A,A+delta]. These four samples and spacing meet the selected grid range and cardinality checks; their ideal planar grade is85/128=0.6640625, above the stored f32 PLAYABLE0.65 limit. In ideal exact arithmetic the allowance (A+delta)×4×2^-23 plus 0.25×the binary32 0.65 value exceeds delta, so the initial branch can return unchanged. At zero offset the same delta exceeds the corresponding tolerance, so the source proceeds into repair instead. The first geographic-preparation path validates the grid, leaves spacing at or below2m unupsampled, and skips initial microrelief for Road samples before invoking that first grade operation. No input, floats, terrain, grade helper, scene or test was run.
conditional_findings.safeguards_and_limits: The bounded illustration assumes an otherwise valid full TacticalSceneInput, valid Road environment samples and a source configuration permitting those values; no complete scene or actual producer has been constructed. Native f64/libm rounding, added detail and the later independent grade constraint, owned support, final collider and actual location remain unverified. A small grade excess may be accepted by intended roundoff policy: decide material tolerance rather than equating any numerical difference with a gameplay defect. The earlier Adler299 record specifically said no bounded counterexample had been newly asserted then; this later95e source analysis does not rewrite or reattribute that earlier statement. PropertySupportMesh normal overflow, sampled-required failure and terrain grade allowance have different first contracts until exact alias proof.
